Subscores: ssim_gated=0.2838 (mean_ssim=0.8972, cubic-gated above 0.70), phash_similarity=0.6375 (mean_hamming=11.6/32), duration=1.0 (60/60 frames). strategy: Frame extraction, color/position tracking, orbital parameter fitting, Revideo parametric animation
agent_behavior: Extracted reference frames at 2fps, 8fps, and 24fps using ffmpeg for progressive analysis
Used PIL/scipy connected components and color-distance matching to identify 10 satellite circles plus central orange disk with their exact hex colors
Computed orbital radii and angular velocities in polar coordinates from tracked positions across all 361 frames
Measured initial angles and angular velocities using linear fits over short windows (first 1 second)
Detected a global radial breathing envelope and modeled it with a smoothstep-based pulse function
Wrote a 99-line Revideo scene using cos/sin orbital mechanics — no per-frame data hardcoded
Iterated twice: first render RMSE=50.78, after tuning smoothstep parameters achieved RMSE=34.66
Completed all work in ~16 minutes out of 2-hour timeout, ran 102 agent turns
